english-language.q2.whiteout.1.all: Left car park at 8am; sky cloudless blue, snow glittering like sugar; well equipped (map, compass, spare gloves, soup flask) with a forecast of dry day; felt smug passing group turning back at stile; by 11 on narrow ridge of rock/old snow with steep drops; enormous views (three lakes, farms, distant sea); stopped to eat sandwich and take photos.

english-language.q2.stammer.1.all: Counted pupils ahead at register and rehearsed 'here' but word wouldn't come out; swapped hard words for easier ones so sentences were odd/roundabout; teacher's report said 'bright but lazy in oral work'; forced to read aloud to class, felt like longest twenty minutes; teachers didn't understand, thought he should try harder/relax.

english-language.q2.cartrace.1.all: Arrived just after dawn at the top; church clock said seven but nobody believed it; teams on steps drinking coffee, arguing about wheels; man in flower-decorated helmet asleep in cart; grandmother handing out pastries; nobody in charge; magnificent carts: bathtub, fish, wardrobe with flapping doors.

english-language.q2.cliffharvest.2.all: Ropes already fixed to iron stakes; Eyrun clips on, checks knot twice, steps backwards into nothing; swings gently against rock face sixty metres down; uses long pole with net to scoop birds from ledges; thousands of adult birds wheel and scream; pushes off with feet and drifts out over the drop.

english-language.q2.cartrace.1.problem: Minor: rules and brakes points are told rather than seen, but enough valid seen points exist.
